items.translation: 创建一个新的 TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy。

items.translation: createContext 在接口 jakarta.jms.ConnectionFactory 中

items.source: Delegates to ConnectionFactoryUtils for automatically participating in thread-bound transactions, for example managed by JmsTransactionManager. createSession calls and close calls on returned Sessions will behave properly within a transaction, that is, always work on the transactional Session. If not within a transaction, normal ConnectionFactory behavior applies.
items.translation: 委托给ConnectionFactoryUtils以自动参与线程绑定的事务，例如由JmsTransactionManager管理的事务。对返回的 Session 调用createSession和close将在事务内正确执行，即始终在事务性 Session 上操作。如果不在事务内，则应用正常的 ConnectionFactory 行为。

items.source: Messaging code which should remain unaware of Spring's JMS support can work with this proxy to seamlessly participate in Spring-managed transactions. Note that the transaction manager, for example JmsTransactionManager, still needs to work with the underlying ConnectionFactory, not with this proxy.
items.translation: 与 Spring 的 JMS 支持无关的消息代码可以使用此代理无缝参与由 Spring 管理的事务。请注意，事务管理器（例如 JmsTransactionManager）仍需与底层的 ConnectionFactory 配合工作，而非与此代理配合。

items.source: Make sure that TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy is the outermost ConnectionFactory of a chain of ConnectionFactory proxies/adapters. TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy can delegate either directly to the target factory or to some intermediary adapter like UserCredentialsConnectionFactoryAdapter.
items.translation: 确保 TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy 是连接工厂代理/适配器链中最外层的 ConnectionFactory。TransactionAwareConnectionFactoryProxy 可以直接委托给目标工厂，也可以委托给某些中间适配器，例如 UserCredentialsConnectionFactoryAdapter。

items.source: Note that transactional JMS Sessions will be registered on a per-Connection basis. To share the same JMS Session across a transaction, make sure that you operate on the same JMS Connection handle - either through reusing the handle or through configuring a SingleConnectionFactory underneath.
items.translation: 请注意，事务性 JMS 会话将按每个连接进行注册。若要跨事务共享同一个 JMS 会话，请确保操作的是同一个 JMS 连接句柄——这可以通过重用该句柄或在下方配置一个SingleConnectionFactory来实现。

items.source: Returned transactional Session proxies will implement the SessionProxy interface to allow for access to the underlying target Session. This is only intended for accessing vendor-specific Session API or for testing purposes (for example, to perform manual transaction control). For typical application purposes, simply use the standard JMS Session interface.
items.translation: 返回的事务性 Session 代理将实现 SessionProxy 接口，以便访问底层的目标 Session。此功能仅用于访问特定于供应商的 Session API 或测试目的（例如执行手动事务控制）。对于典型的应用程序用途，只需使用标准的 JMS Session 接口即可。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 5, this class delegates JMS 2.0 JMSContext calls and therefore requires the JMS 2.0 API to be present at runtime. It may nevertheless run against a JMS 1.1 driver (bound to the JMS 2.0 API) as long as no actual JMS 2.0 calls are triggered by the application's setup.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 5 起，该类委托了 JMS 2.0 `JMSContext` 调用，因此需要在运行时存在 JMS 2.0 API。尽管如此，只要应用程序的配置不会触发实际的 JMS 2.0 调用，它仍可与绑定到 JMS 2.0 API 的 JMS 1.1 驱动程序一起运行。

items.source:
Default is "false": If not within a managed transaction that encompasses
the underlying JMS ConnectionFactory, standard Sessions will be returned.
Turn this flag on to allow participation in any Spring-managed transaction,
with a local JMS transaction synchronized with the main transaction.
items.translation: 默认为"false"：如果不在包含底层 JMS ConnectionFactory 的管理事务中，将返回标准 Session。将此标志设置为 true 以允许参与任何 Spring 管理的事务，并使本地 JMS 事务与主事务同步。

items.source: Return the target ConnectionFactory that this ConnectionFactory should delegate to.
items.translation: 返回此 ConnectionFactory 应委托的目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:
Wrap the given Connection with a proxy that delegates every method call to it
but handles Session lookup in a transaction-aware fashion.
items.translation: 将给定的 `Connection` 包装在一个代理中，该代理将所有方法调用委托给它，但以事务感知的方式处理会话查找。

items.source:
Return whether to allow for a local JMS transaction that is synchronized
with a Spring-managed transaction.
items.translation: 返回是否允许同步本地 JMS 事务与 Spring 管理的事务。

items.source: Set the target ConnectionFactory that this ConnectionFactory should delegate to.
items.translation: 设置此 ConnectionFactory 应委托的目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:
Set whether to allow for a local JMS transaction that is synchronized with a
Spring-managed transaction (where the main transaction might be a JDBC-based
one for a specific DataSource, for example), with the JMS transaction committing
right after the main transaction.
items.translation: 设置是否允许本地 JMS 事务与 Spring 管理的事务同步（例如，主事务可能是针对特定 DataSource 的基于 JDBC 的事务），并在主事务提交后立即提交 JMS 事务。
